subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should env-less Native Windows gateway restarts probe an installed Scheduled Task, and if so which default/profile/custom task name is authoritative for the restart handoff?
rationale: Fallback and supervisor detection behavior is compatibility-sensitive because a false positive can make the running gateway exit before the intended replacement task is proven available.

options.title: Review Linked PR With Task-Name Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR or replacement to probe the same task name the handoff will run, with Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

options.title: Keep Env-Marker-Only Detection
options.body: Reject the requested behavior and document that manually-started Windows gateways without service markers intentionally stay in-process unless relaunched via the Scheduled Task.

options.title: Split Broader Windows Restart Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to env-missing Scheduled Task detection and track schtasks failure diagnostics or half-state recovery in the broader Windows restart issues.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR With Task-Name Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked PR or replacement to probe the same task name the handoff will run, with Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Windows Scheduled Task restart path and marker detection this decision would refine.
